assumptions.port_current: U6.10 PGND only; J1.1/12 USB return source, shell not driven; six equal current GH contacts. No ideal short among U6 control ground pins.

limitations: Linear triangular DC sheet FEM on actual GND fill polygons including holes and thermal spokes, actual GND tracks, pads and plated vias; source pad equipotential approximation
Width -20% applied to actual ground tracks; filled plane and thermal spokes use native geometry. Plane/thermal etch and actual stackup/plating/copper minima remain manufacturing inputs
Mesh convergence is a numerical check, not a manufacturing worst-case guarantee
No contact, harness or component resistance included; use separate system model
